ValidationRule.description: DEPRECATED - Cancelled Status can only be used by Sys Admin profile as of now
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , OR( AND( ISNEW() , ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c , "Cancelled" ) ) , AND( ISCHANGED( NSP_Status__c ) , ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( NSP_Status__c ) , "Cancelled" ) , NOT( ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c , "Cancelled" ) ) ), AND( ISCHANGED( NSP_Status__c ) , ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c , "Cancelled" ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to set the status to "Cancelled" at this time.
